Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 446 AM EDT Tue Oct 13 2026

- Breezy with well above normal warmth today.

- Scattered showers tonight into tomorrow south of I-69.

- Turning more seasonable tomorrow into Thursday with additional 
  rainfall Thursday afternoon into Thursday night.

- Strong cold front brings more windy conditions Friday as 
  conditions becomes chillier Friday night into Saturday.

&&

.AVIATION...

Last pockets of light showers are vacating the area early this 
morning setting the stage for a VFR, mostly sunny day for the bulk 
of the terminals. A lingering frontal boundary over northern lower 
MI keeps lower VFR cloud cover near MBS with guidance suggesting it 
gradually expands back of the airport by afternoon. Respectable 
remnant gradient over southern lower MI today leads to a breezier 
day with southwest gusts able to reach peak gusts of 25-30kts during 
the daylight hours. Aforementioned frontal boundary sags south 
through the area overnight as a shortwave tracks across the northern 
Ohio Valley. This offers another round of scattered showers with 
isolated thunder chances mainly south of I-69.

D21/DTW Convection... Passing wave to the south as a weak cold front 
sags through tonight offers a low chance for isolated thunder 
however probability at the airport is too low to currently mention 
in TAF.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Low for thunderstorms tonight.
